summary: fund-calculator preinstall exfiltrates host and project identifiers to hardcoded OAST callback
details: Package declares a preinstall script (`node index.js`) that fires unconditionally on `npm install`. index.js reads installer-side identifiers via `os.hostname()`, `os.userInfo()`, `INIT_CWD`, home directory, and the parent project's package.json (name/author/repository/homepage), and additionally resolves the installer's public IP via https requests to api.ipify.org, icanhazip.com, and ifconfig.me. The collected data is transmitted to the hardcoded callback `da51rv0hb2uc72tg4gvgdepinjcallbk1.oast.fun` over three channels: HTTP POST to port 80, HTTPS POST to port 443 on path `/poc/${uuid}`, and DNS resolution of hex-encoded payload chunks (Buffer.from(body).toString('hex') split into 60-character labels) emitted as subdomains under the callback host to bypass egress filters that permit DNS but block outbound HTTP. The 999.9.12 version number and package name are consistent with a dependency-confusion name-squat designed to win resolution against a private internal package of the same name.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
